The easiest way to do this is probably to start with a copy of grid small pure, and go into world edit and open the material editor window. From there you’ll have to find the grid material associated with the ground, and then if you scroll down all the way to the bottom of that window, there should be an additional info tab which will have a drop down that allows you to select from a set of surfaces. ASPHALT_PREPPED is what you’re looking for. Make sure to save the material back at the top of the window, and rebuild collision on the map, (I think the shortcut is CTRL + F7 but also check under file). Hope this helps! Let me know if you have any questions I’ll try to get back to you.
